name: io.github.cyanheads/ilostat-mcp-server
description: Search ILOSTAT labour indicators, query and compare series, build country profiles, run SQL.

environmentVariables.name: ILOSTAT_CATALOG_REFRESH_HOURS
environmentVariables.description: Hours between checks of the ILOSTAT tables of contents (1–168).

environmentVariables.name: ILOSTAT_MAX_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on the rows one query may return or stage (1,000–1,000,000).

environmentVariables.name: ILOSTAT_PREVIEW_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Inline preview budget in serialized characters; a larger result is staged as a dataframe.

environmentVariables.name: ILOSTAT_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a small upstream data response stays cached (0 disables the cache).

environmentVariables.name: ILOSTAT_DATASET_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Per-table TTL for staged dataframes, in seconds (at least 60).

environmentVariables.name: ILOSTAT_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose ilostat_dataframe_drop; staged dataframes otherwise expire on their TTL.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: DataCanvas engine for staged dataframes: duckdb (default) or none to turn dataframes off.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Selects the HTTP transport.
